mapper.select: SELECT BUSINESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, OPEN_DATE, LICENSE_FILE_PATH, NTS_BUSINESS_STATUS, NTS_CHECKED_AT, REJECT_REASON, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, GRADE_NAME, CUSTOM_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE REPLACE(BUSINESS_NUMBER, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{businessNumber}, '-', '')
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_BUSINESS_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BUSINESS ( BUSINESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, OPEN_DATE, LICENSE_FILE_PATH, NTS_BUSINESS_STATUS, NTS_CHECKED_AT, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, GRADE_NAME, CUSTOM_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{businessNo}, #{memberNo}, #{businessName}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{openDate}, #{licenseFilePath}, #{ntsBusinessStatus}, SYSDATE, #{bankName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolder}, 'BRONZE', NULL, 'WAITING', SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_NO, BUSINESS_NO, CONTENT_NO, ACTOR_NO, PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_TYPE, PRICE, DISCOUNT_RATE, STOCK, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{businessNo}, #{contentNo}, #{actorNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{stock}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT_IMAGE_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGE ( IMAGE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_PATH, IS_MAIN ) VALUES ( #{imageNo}, #{productNo}, #{imagePath}, #{isMain} )
mapper.select:
SELECT CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, POSTER_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, AGE_RATING FROM CONTENT WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR UPPER(ORIGINAL_TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY CONTENT_NO DESC
SELECT CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, POSTER_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, AGE_RATING FROM CONTENT WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
SELECT ACTOR_NO, TMDB_ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NAME, PROFILE_PATH FROM ACTOR ORDER BY ACTOR_NAME ASC

SELECT A.ACTOR_NO, A.TMDB_ACTOR_ID, A.ACTOR_NAME, A.PROFILE_PATH, CA.CHARACTER_NAME, CA.DISPLAY_ORDER FROM CONTENT_ACTOR CA
JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = CA.ACTOR_NO
WHERE CA.CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
ORDER BY CA.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC NULLS LAST, A.ACTOR_NAME ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT,
C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, A.ACTOR_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH
FROM PRODUCT P
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT,
C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, A.ACTOR_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH
FROM PRODUCT P
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT,
C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, A.ACTOR_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_NO FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_NO,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH,
'Y' AS IS_MAIN
FROM PRODUCT P
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}, ACTOR_NO = #{actorNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, PRODUCT_TYPE = #{productType}, PRICE = #{price}, DISCOUNT_RATE = #{discountRate}, STOCK = #{stock}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, STATUS = #{status} WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND P.STATUS != 'DELETE_REQUESTED'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN EVENT E ON E.EVENT_NO = EP.EVENT_NO WHERE EP.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND E.STATUS IN ('WAITING', 'APPROVED') )
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_EVENT_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO EVENT ( EVENT_NO, TITLE, BANNER_IMAGE, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{eventNo}, #{title}, #{bannerImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_EVENT_PROD_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO EVENT_PRODUCT ( EVENT_PROD_NO, EVENT_NO, PRODUCT_NO, EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE ) VALUES ( #{eventProdNo}, #{eventNo}, #{productNo}, #{discountRate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT EP.EVENT_PROD_NO, EP.EVENT_NO, EP.PRODUCT_NO, EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE AS DISCOUNT_RATE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE
FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP
JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = #{eventNo}
ORDER BY EP.EVENT_PROD_NO

SELECT E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.BANNER_IMAGE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.STATUS, E.CREATED_AT, LISTAGG(P.PRODUCT_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EP.EVENT_PROD_NO) AS PRODUCT_NAME, MIN(P.PRICE) AS PRICE, MAX(EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE) AS EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE
FROM EVENT E
JOIN EVENT_PRODUCT EP ON EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO
JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP2 JOIN PRODUCT P2 ON P2.PRODUCT_NO = EP2.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP2.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P2.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )
AND ( UPPER(E.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR UPPER(E.STATUS) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP3 JOIN PRODUCT P3 ON P3.PRODUCT_NO = EP3.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP3.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P3.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND UPPER(P3.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
GROUP BY E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.BANNER_IMAGE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.STATUS, E.CREATED_AT
ORDER BY E.EVENT_NO DESC

SELECT E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.BANNER_IMAGE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.STATUS, E.CREATED_AT
FROM EVENT E
WHERE E.EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND E.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENT E SET TITLE = #{title}, BANNER_IMAGE = #{bannerImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DATE = #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, END_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, STATUS = 'WAITING' WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )

UPDATE EVENT E SET END_DATE = #{extendEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, STATUS = 'WAITING' WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )
